english.title: Disclose details of an interception warrant - RIPA
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) following the

(A)_[issue]_
(B)_[renewal]_

of an interception warrant and being a person who falls within section 19(2) of the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000, namely **(..SPECIFY..), disclosed to another, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..)

(C)_[the existence and contents of the warrant and of any Section 8(4) certificate in relation to the warrant, namely **(..SPECIFY CONTENTS..)]_
(D)_[the details of the issue of the warrant and of any renewal or modification of the warrant or of any Section 8(4) certificate in relation to the warrant, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)]_
(E)_[the existence and contents of any requirement to provide assistance with giving effect to the warrant, namely **(..SPECIFY CONTENTS..)]_
(F)_[the steps taken in pursuance of the warrant or of any requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT..), to provide assistance with giving effect to the warrant]_
(G)_[anything in the intercepted material, together with any related communication data, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 19(4) of the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the current offence, please see H18712.(ii) See section 19(2) for a list of people required to keep secret details of an interception warrant.
(iii) See section 19(3) for the matters that are required to be kept secret under section 19(1).
(iv) See section 19(5), (6), (7) and (9) for defences.
(v) See section 20 for an interpretation of "intercepted material" and "related communications".

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
